description: The main window on desktop: self-update and relaunch (UPD-001-006), the process log and its folder (LOG-008), and the Sharing settings pane for Remote Login (R-059; it fails as unavailable on Linux). The updater and process plugins are registered in release builds only, so in a debug build their permissions grant nothing. Known width: a script in the web view may pass headers, timeout, proxy and target to check, and may relaunch the app; it cannot change the key, the endpoints or the downgrade rule (WP-04b final review C-1).
